title: Technology Internship Program
desc:
About Paribu
Founded in 2017, Paribu has been playing a key role in the development of Türkiye’s crypto asset ecosystem by delivering innovative blockchain-based products and services. It offers a fast, easy, and secure exchange experience with more than 210 crypto assets.
In 2024, Paribu introduced Paribu Custody, one of the few globally digital asset custody solutions tailored for institutional clients. At the same time, Paribu offers a secure self-custody experience for individuals and startups through its next-generation crypto wallet solution, Paribu Self. Beyond its mission to increase blockchain adoption, Paribu is committed to shaping the future by actively supporting
culture, arts, sports,
and
education
.
Why join Paribu?
Paribu works with
curious, innovative,
and
impact-driven professionals
who are passionate about pushing boundaries and driving technological advancement. It fosters a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and sharing. Whether you specialise in
technology, design, strategy, operations, or beyond
, you will be part of a team shaping the future of finance.
Paribu provides a working environment where ideas turn into reality, and innovation thrives. Here, you'll work alongside talented professionals, tackle exciting challenges, and contribute to meaningful projects that align with Paribu’s vision of delivering fast, easy, and secure experiences.
The impact you'll make
At Paribu, every team member plays a crucial role in driving innovation and delivering high-quality solutions. Through our Technology Internship Program, our Tech team is hiring
both Software Engineering and Product interns
this cycle. Whichever track you join, you will be responsible for:
Supporting engineering and product teams in the development, testing, and improvement of software products
Contributing to ongoing projects while gaining hands-on experience in real-world development environments
Collaborating with engineers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to understand problems and contribute to practical solutions
Participating in coding, testing, and debugging (Software Engineering track), or in product discovery, requirement writing, and documentation (Product track)
Learning and applying modern software development and product practices, tools, and technologies
Exploring AI-assisted development and product tools to support your learning experience
Key competencies
We value potential, curiosity, and willingness to learn as much as experience. We're looking for:
4th-year undergraduate students
in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, graduating in 2027
Availability to work
3–4 days
per week throughout the program
Software Engineering track:
Solid CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, OOP), basic knowledge of at least one programming language (Java, Go, Python, JavaScript/Node.js, C#), and familiarity with Git, SQL/NoSQL, and frontend technologies
Product track:
Strong analytical thinking, a basic understanding of how software products are built, and comfort working with data to support decision-making
Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity about new technologies, and a collaborative mindset
Please indicate in your application which track (Software Engineering or Product) you are applying for.
The advantages of being at Paribu
Paribu invests in its team’s growth, well-being, and happiness. Here’s what you can expect:
Meal allowance
– Generous support with a flexible meal card.
Private health insurance
– Comprehensive coverage for employees, including
spouse and children
.
Commuting support
– Financial support for commuting based on your office route.
S.O.S. leave (10 days)
– Additional leave days up to 10 days per year for urgent and unexpected matters, apart from annual leave.
Birthday leave
– One
extra day off
during your birthday month.
Language learning support
– Resources to enhance English communication skills.
Personal development support
– Budget for exploring hobbies, attending professional courses, and personal growth.
Well-being & health platform
– Access to digital health and wellness services, including mental health support, and well-being resources.
Top-tier work equipment
– High-performance devices and all the essential tools you need to do your best work.
Cultural events
– Enjoy
concerts, theater, cinema,
and
sports tickets
through company-sponsored raffles.
The hiring journey
From application to onboarding, here's a step-by-step look at your journey with Paribu.
1. Application:
Submit your application online.
2. Initial screening:
People Team reviews your resume.
3. Assessment tests:
Complete a case study or technical test to help us better understand your problem-solving and technical skills.
4. Panel Interview:
Meet with team members.
5. Office Interview:
Meet with hiring managers.
6. Offer & onboarding:
If it’s a great fit, you will be welcomed on board.
Application process
Should you have already applied, here are two essential facts about the process:
While we carefully review every application, only candidates whose profiles best align with the role will be contacted. We appreciate your understanding on this matter.
All applications received by Paribu are treated equally, without prejudice to age, gender, religion, race, disability, or marital status, in full compliance with personal data protection principles.
In accordance with applicable data protection regulations, please note the following:
You have been informed that my personal data is processed by Paribu Teknoloji A.Ş. (“Paribu” or “Company”) through the “
Paribu Teknoloji A.Ş. Clarification Text on the Protection of Personal Data for Employee Candidates
” prepared as part of the job application process of employee candidates and in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.
